records.name: Straight Stop, Pause and Announced Walking Exit — Teaching Proposal
records.identityDecision: Same proposed controlled stopped/opening-step identity with two positive-pause delivery contexts; no automatic new canonical owner or exact existing1s profile. Human owner/profile resolution remains required.

full_2s: Actual controlled corresponding walking or gentle-jog stop, comfortable ordinary walking/standing/small step-turn components, understood early-announced side and actual verified route/supervision.

First full-pause exit instruction does not require prior successful complete exit. Current counted P2 may establish only the walking-stop component. A first jogging-stop lesson stays terminal-only; easy jogging or walking stopping does not establish a retained controlled jogging stop.
Retained full-pause work uses actual compatible approach, direction, geometry, ordinary exit, dose and current response.
first_1s: Actual repeatable corresponding full 2-second stop/opening-step/ordinary-exit task at the same approach, announced direction, geometry and intent; current components, response, conduct, space and supervision fit.

The first 1-second attempt is counted instruction and needs no prior successful 1-second attempt. A P2 walking stop, a static stance, attendance or one emerging full-pause result is not the required whole-task repeatability.
The opposite direction is evaluated independently. Use only that direction’s actual evidence; no assumed bilateral pass or repayment attempt.
retained_1s: Actual repeatable same-approach, direction, geometry, stopped/opening-step/ordinary-walking-exit and 1-second pause evidence with current suitable response, conduct, space and supervision.
No reconstruction of an older 2-second record is required. One first or emerging 1-second result and narrow preparation observations are not repeatability.
Retain actual smaller opportunities, approach/intent, exit/finish, recovery and qualified direction; no automatic pause removal, immediate cutting or opposite-side pass.

Direct retained same-context jogging stop/exit evidence requires the actual controlled corresponding jog stop, repeatable selected 1-second direction/approach/intent task, comfortable ordinary walking/turning and current fit. It does not require reconstructing an older walking-stop or full 2-second record. First new terminal jogging stopping still requires its actual controlled walking-stop/easy-jog components; it cannot be combined with a first exit.

records.mechanics: Reach an actually controlled bilateral stop at the retained walking or gentle-jog approach. Hold for the selected full2 seconds or independently eligible shorter1 second, counted only after the genuine stop. Use exit-side small opening steps, lifting/replanting both feet so body/feet turn together into the early-announced2 m approximately45-degree ordinary walking exit. Finish with a separate quiet bilateral2-second hold, clear outward and take the segregated return with full recovery. Each assigned opportunity selects its own direction/context; first instruction, retention and actual completion remain distinct.

doseProfiles.purpose: Teach or retain the exact full2-second stopped ordinary exit under its component gates.
doseProfiles.qualityGate: Actual controlled corresponding bilateral stop first, then full2-second positive pause, early-announced correct side, ordinary lifting/replanting opening steps without pivot/crossover/cut,2 m45-degree walking exit, separate quiet bilateral2-second finish and safe clearance/return. Record actual action; entry permission is not completion.
stopRules: Stop the affected task for symptoms, apprehension, participant request, restrictions, unsafe surface/traffic, loss of balance or unclear conduct.

Do not open/turn before a genuinely controlled corresponding bilateral stop and the full selected positive pause. A rushed or unstable finish is not a valid shorter-pause result. Record the actual pause and partial work; restore an independently suitable held task or stop without an added attempt.
End the affected exit for fixed-foot pivot, crossover, hard sidestep cut, immediate acceleration, wrong or late-announced direction, unsafe foot placement or uncontrolled terminal finish.
Actual longer instruction, braking, clearance or return delays/omits later work. Do not add an athlete walkthrough, substitute attempt, opposite-side debt, faster release or shorter recovery.

dosage.sharedOpportunityPool: One total across full2s and shorter1s contexts and eligible route alternatives. Select one exact context per assigned opportunity/direction; do not add profile ceilings. First complete instruction is existing E1 opportunity1.
dosage.clockRule: Both pause values retain20s active/clearance plus45s return and25s release headway. One saved second only adds clearance slack; no extra effort, forced pace or shortened recovery.

timeModel.delayRule: Actual slower stabilization/action/return delays or omits later work; shorter pause creates slack only.
timeModel.singleOpportunityRule: No between-repeat interval exists for one opportunity; still preserve at least 60 s after complete work/return before a later relevant role. Actual delays remove later work rather than compress recovery.

doseScaling.directionRule: Record first side LEFT/RIGHT; assigned order is the actual first/opposite/first prefix. Select each direction/context independently. An unavailable opposite slot is terminal/deferred, not reassigned to add first-side work; no repeatability or side debt from a single emerging attempt.
doseScaling.L: Walking only; preserve independently eligible full or shorter pause and actual lower dose.
doseScaling.progression: No pause removal, cue change, approach increase, support removal, new load/handling or opportunity increase. Only later actual repeatability can support its separately reviewed next task.
doseScaling.unknownLongitudinalCountPolicy: When selected main movement is independently eligible but longitudinal count is unknown, use one original counted opportunity or omit; keep prior count null. This is a current planning ceiling, not a claimed historical reduction. Known smaller/zero work or restrictions govern; missing attendance is not fabricated completed zero work.

main.rule: One total across routes/context; no additional direction or fault repayment.

stance.rule: Independent min(selected cap, reference) per lead; learn_high P1 quiet, S1 counted high. Preserve support and actual depth; no universal tall reset.

retainedStrengthBoundaries.knee: One supported static mid-range, retained high or independently eligible counted learn-high set. P1/S1 preserve actual per-lead holds through 25 combinations of 1–5-second ceilings; P1 at most 3 s per lead, S1 D5/L3. Quiet P1 is independent of S1 and provides no split pass. Static stance is not compatible bilateral squat unloading.
retainedStrengthBoundaries.hip: One currently familiar bodyweight or D-only independently familiar TWO-DB RDL set. Same actual pair/load/range/elevated parking, no first loaded handling or older-load restoration over newer unloaded work. Exact 1/2/3-repetition caps; unknown BW history at most 2 only after actual current familiarity, actual 1 governs.
retainedStrengthBoundaries.pushPull: Current familiar stable incline push, exact opposite-hand-and-knee bench row or independently familiar suspension row. Retain reference/low and exact count/side packets, load, support and response; no first support or loaded handling lesson.
retainedStrengthBoundaries.brace: Eligible fixed-arm bent-leg heel contacts/returns or passive full-lower-leg-supported simultaneous bilateral breathing. First breathing instruction is permitted within the counted set from independently suitable floor transfer/support/bilateral arm/breathing components; no prior whole breathing success or heel-tap pass. Actual smaller cycles/side counts govern.
retainedStrengthBoundaries.stanceUnknownDurationPolicy: With actually current familiar support/depth/controlled entry and exit but unknown historical hold duration, P1 and S1 use at most 1 s on that eligible lead; the other lead keeps its own actual smaller ceiling. Prior seconds remain null. Unknown duration alone does not force first-high. A known zero or ineligible lead excludes the positive both-lead packet: independently eligible quiet P1 and other roles may remain, while S1 is deferred.

sessionBinding.completeSessionScope: Scoped local source/context comparison only. Independent complete cohort/traffic/workload numeric audit, human exact identity/release, actual athlete/facility and separate tumbling gates remain separate.
sessionBinding.retainedJogHistoryPolicy: Direct retained same-context jogging stop/exit evidence requires the actual controlled corresponding jog stop, repeatable selected 1-second direction/approach/intent task, comfortable ordinary walking/turning and current fit. It does not require reconstructing an older walking-stop or full 2-second record. First new terminal jogging stopping still requires its actual controlled walking-stop/easy-jog components; it cannot be combined with a first exit.

stance_history_policy.known_zero_or_ineligible_lead: Do not perform the positive both-lead stance packet; use eligible quiet P1 and defer S1 under this lesson. Other independently eligible roles remain available.
